commonErrorCodes.400: Bad Request — Invalid input data or malformed JSON
commonErrorCodes.401: Unauthorized — Authentication required or token invalid/expired
commonErrorCodes.404: Not Found — Resource does not exist
commonErrorCodes.405: Method Not Allowed — HTTP method not supported on this endpoint
commonErrorCodes.406: Not Acceptable — Requested media type not supported
commonErrorCodes.409: Conflict — Resource already exists, duplicate key, or delete-with-dependents
commonErrorCodes.413: Content Too Large — Request body exceeds size limit
commonErrorCodes.415: Unsupported Media Type — Wrong Content-Type (e.g., not application/json)
commonErrorCodes.422: Unprocessable Entity — Structurally valid JSON but fails business validation
commonErrorCodes.428: Precondition Required — If-Match header required but not sent
commonErrorCodes.429: Too Many Requests — Rate limit exceeded
commonErrorCodes.500: Internal Server Error — Unexpected server error

owaspApiTop10.name: BOLA / IDOR
owaspApiTop10.description: Object-level authorization: user A attempts to access or modify user B's resource using a valid token

owaspApiTop10.name: Broken Authentication
owaspApiTop10.description: Request with missing token, expired token, or malformed token

owaspApiTop10.name: Excessive Data Exposure
owaspApiTop10.description: Response body contains sensitive fields (password hash, internal IDs, private metadata) that should not be returned

owaspApiTop10.name: BFLA — Function-Level Authorization
owaspApiTop10.description: Low-privilege user calls an admin-only endpoint (e.g., bulk delete, role assignment)

owaspApiTop10.name: Mass Assignment
owaspApiTop10.description: Request body contains extra privileged fields (e.g., role, isAdmin, ownerId) that should be ignored
owaspApiTop10.expectedResult: Privileged fields silently ignored; 200/201 with unmodified privileged values

owaspApiTop10.name: Injection
owaspApiTop10.description: Input fields contain SQL injection, XSS payloads, or OS command fragments
owaspApiTop10.expectedResult: Input sanitized; no code executed; 400 or 422

idempotency.description: Repeat identical PUT or DELETE requests must return the same result (2nd call returns same 200/204, not 409)

optimisticConcurrency.description: If API uses ETags/If-Match, send a stale ETag and expect 412; send no ETag when required and expect 428

contentNegotiation.description: Send wrong Content-Type (e.g., text/plain) for mutation endpoints → 415; request unsupported Accept type → 406

payloadTooLarge.description: Send a request body that exceeds the server payload size limit → 413

methodNotAllowed.description: Call an unsupported HTTP method on a known endpoint (e.g., DELETE on a read-only resource) → 405

locationHeader.description: Successful POST that creates a resource must return a Location header pointing to the new resource

bodyPathMismatch.description: PUT where the ID in the URL differs from the ID in the body — must return 400 or 422, not silently override

patchNullVsOmit.description: PATCH: null explicitly clears a field; omitting the key leaves the field unchanged — test both behaviors

duplicatePost.description: POST with identical unique fields a second time → 409 Conflict

deleteWithDependents.description: DELETE a resource that has dependent child records — confirm 409 Conflict or cascaded delete per API contract

softVsHardDelete.description: DELETE — confirm whether the operation is soft (status flag) or hard (permanent removal); subsequent GET should reflect the correct state
